Operated by: Lorenzo La Cognata
Effective date: June 30, 2026 · Last updated: June 30, 2026
tos_s01_text: By accessing, using, or purchasing services from CompanionAway, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use our services. By completing payment and submitting a questionnaire, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to all terms herein.
tos_s02_intro: CompanionAway offers two service categories with the following plans:
tos_s02_reloc_li1: Explorer: Free access to basic relocation resources and community.
tos_s02_reloc_li2: Settler: €159 one-time. Customized relocation guide tailored to your destination, including destination research, logistics, visa overview, cost breakdown, and practical checklists.
tos_s02_reloc_li3: Roots: €209 one-time. Premium relocation guide with deeper personalization, extended support, and comprehensive cultural orientation guidance specific to your situation and destination.
tos_s02_travel_li1: Explorer: Free forever access to basic travel inspiration and tips.
tos_s02_travel_li2: Escape: €99 per trip. Customized 1–3 day travel itinerary tailored to your interests, budget, and travel style. Includes day-by-day recommendations and logistics.
tos_s02_travel_li3: Discover: €169 per trip. Customized 4–7 day travel itinerary with deeper local insights, restaurant recommendations, and activity suggestions.
tos_s02_travel_li4: Immerse: €249 per trip. Customized 8–14 day immersive travel itinerary with comprehensive local expertise, cultural guidance, and detailed logistics.
tos_s02_outro: All services are delivered as digital documents (HTML/PDF). They are tailored based on your questionnaire responses and do not constitute professional legal, tax, financial, immigration, or medical advice.
tos_s03_p1: Pricing is fixed and non-negotiable. All prices are displayed on the website and apply to all customers equally.
tos_s03_p2: Payment is due in full upfront via credit card (Stripe) before work begins. CompanionAway accepts Visa, Mastercard, and other major credit cards. Payment constitutes acceptance of these Terms.
tos_s03_p3: Currency conversion: If you pay from a non-EUR currency, your bank's exchange rate applies. CompanionAway is not responsible for exchange rate fluctuations, currency conversion fees, or your bank's processing fees.
tos_s04_p1: Full refund (100%): Cancel within 24 hours of payment. You will receive a full refund, no questions asked.
tos_s04_p2: Partial refund (50%): Cancel after 24 hours but before work begins (within 1 business day). You will receive 50% refund.
tos_s04_p3: No refund: Once work has begun (questionnaire reviewed, research started, draft created), the service is non-refundable. "Work begun" is defined as the moment CompanionAway starts researching or writing your customized content, as evidenced by internal timestamps.
tos_s04_p4: How cancellation works: Email hello@companionaway.com with "CANCEL: [Order ID]" and your name. Include the email used for purchase. Refunds are processed within 7 business days via Stripe to your original payment method. You will receive a confirmation email.
tos_s04_p5: Revisions after delivery: If you receive your guide/itinerary and want revisions, the following apply based on your plan:
tos_s04_li1: Relocation — Settler: 1 revision included (significant changes to content, not minor edits)
tos_s04_li3: Travel — Escape / Discover / Immerse: 1 revision included per purchase
tos_s04_p6: Revisions must be requested within 14 days of delivery. Additional revisions beyond the plan are €50 each. No refunds are issued for subjective dissatisfaction after delivery (e.g., "I don't like the recommendations"); refunds are only available within the 24/50-hour window noted above.
tos_s05_p1: Standard delivery: 5–7 business days after payment and questionnaire completion.
tos_s05_p2: Express delivery: Available for an additional €50 (3–4 business days).
tos_s05_p3: Business days are Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Central Time, excluding US federal holidays. Weekends and holidays do not count toward delivery time. CompanionAway will send email confirmation when your guide is ready.
tos_s06_p1: Ownership: All content you receive (guides, itineraries, recommendations, research) is created by CompanionAway and remains our intellectual property.
tos_s06_p2: Your usage rights: You receive a personal, non-transferable license to view and use the guide for your own relocation or travel purposes only. You may:
tos_s06_may_li1: View and read the guide on your personal devices
tos_s06_may_li3: Share the link with immediate family members (spouse, children, close relatives) who will also be part of your relocation/trip
tos_s06_not_li1: Sell, resell, or monetize the guide in any way
tos_s06_not_li2: Republish, reproduce, or distribute it on your website, blog, social media, or other public platform
tos_s06_not_li3: Share it beyond immediate family, or with other relocating individuals or travel groups
tos_s06_not_li4: Use it as a template or basis for creating competing services
tos_s06_not_li5: Remove or alter CompanionAway branding or attribution
tos_s06_p4: Unauthorized use constitutes copyright infringement and may result in legal action and damages.
tos_s07_alert: CompanionAway provides INFORMATIONAL GUIDES ONLY. We are not liable for any outcomes of your relocation or travel decisions.
tos_s07_p1: WHAT WE DO NOT PROVIDE: CompanionAway does not provide professional legal, tax, financial, immigration, medical, or insurance advice. Our guides are informational and educational only.
tos_s07_resp_li1: Verifying all information (visa requirements, costs, availability) independently with official sources
tos_s07_resp_li2: Consulting with qualified professionals (immigration lawyer, tax advisor, financial planner) for your specific situation
tos_s07_resp_li3: Compliance with all local, state, and federal laws in your origin and destination countries
tos_s07_resp_li4: Your own research, decision-making, and actions based on the guide
tos_s07_p3_label: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY: CompanionAway, its owner, and all associated parties are not liable for:
tos_s07_liab_li1: Financial losses, currency fluctuations, or unexpected costs during relocation or travel
tos_s07_liab_li2: Visa denials, immigration issues, or delays in immigration processing
tos_s07_liab_li3: Changes in laws, policies, prices, or availability of services/housing after guide delivery
tos_s07_liab_li4: Restaurant closures, business changes, or inaccuracies in third-party recommendations
tos_s07_liab_li5: Personal injuries, accidents, theft, or safety issues during travel
tos_s07_liab_li6: Missed flights, accommodation failures, or travel logistics problems
tos_s07_liab_li7: Errors or omissions in the guide due to information changing between research and delivery
tos_s07_liab_li8: Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
tos_s07_p4: IN NO EVENT SHALL COMPANIONAWAY'S TOTAL LIABILITY EXCEED THE AMOUNT YOU PAID FOR THE SERVICE. This is the maximum amount we are legally responsible for, regardless of the nature of the claim.
tos_s07_p5: By purchasing a guide, you assume all risk and responsibility for how you use the information. CompanionAway is a guide provider, not a guarantee provider.
tos_s08_p1: If you dispute a charge with your credit card company or issue a chargeback without first contacting CompanionAway, you agree that:
tos_s08_li1: CompanionAway will cancel your order and deny you access to your guide
tos_s08_li2: CompanionAway may suspend or ban your account and email address from future purchases
tos_s08_li3: You will still be liable for chargeback fees and processing costs passed to CompanionAway
tos_s08_p2: If you have a legitimate issue with your purchase, contact hello@companionaway.com FIRST before disputing with your bank. We will work to resolve the issue directly.
tos_s09_p1: CompanionAway retains your questionnaire data and personal information as follows:
tos_s09_li1: Active customers: Your data is retained for 12 months after purchase to provide service support and revisions
tos_s09_li2: Inactive accounts: After 12 months with no contact or purchases, your data is securely deleted
tos_s09_li3: Your request: You may request deletion of your data at any time by emailing hello@companionaway.com with "DELETE MY DATA" and your name. Deletion will be processed within 30 days.
tos_s09_p2: See our Privacy Policy for full details on data handling, GDPR rights, and how your information is used.
tos_s10_p1: CompanionAway reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon posting. Your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the modified terms. We will notify you of material changes via email if you have provided one.
tos_s11_p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Minnesota, USA. Any dispute arising from these Terms shall be resolved through:
tos_s11_li1: First: Good-faith negotiation between you and CompanionAway via email
tos_s11_li3: Final: Binding arbitration under Minnesota law (not a court lawsuit)
tos_s11_p2: You waive your right to a jury trial by agreeing to these Terms.
tos_s12_p1: For questions, disputes, refund requests, or support, email: hello@companionaway.com
privacy_s01_p1: When you fill the questionnaire: Name, email, destination(s), travel dates, budget, preferences, interests, family composition, dietary restrictions, accessibility needs, and any other information you provide in the form.
privacy_s01_p2: Payment information: We do NOT collect or store credit card details. Stripe (our payment processor) handles all payment data. See Stripe's privacy policy for their data handling.
privacy_s01_p3: Website usage data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent, via Google Analytics (optional, user can opt out).
privacy_s02_li1: To create your guide: Your questionnaire data is used exclusively to research and write your customized relocation guide or travel itinerary
privacy_s02_li2: To communicate: Email you delivery confirmations, revisions, and support responses
privacy_s02_li3: To improve our service: Anonymized data helps us understand what guides are most popular and improve our process
privacy_s02_li4: For legal compliance: We keep records for tax and business purposes (12 months minimum)
privacy_s02_p1: We do NOT: Sell your data, share it with marketers, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties except as required by law.
privacy_s03_p1: If you are a resident of the EU, California, or another jurisdiction with data protection laws, you have the following rights:
privacy_s03_li1: Right to access: Request a copy of all data CompanionAway has about you
privacy_s03_li2: Right to deletion: Request deletion of your data (we will comply within 30 days, except where legally required to retain it)
privacy_s03_li3: Right to correction: Request corrections to inaccurate data
privacy_s03_li4: Right to portability: Request your data in a machine-readable format
privacy_s03_li5: Right to opt-out: Opt out of marketing emails (though we rarely send these)
privacy_s03_p2: To exercise these rights, email hello@companionaway.com with "DATA REQUEST: [Your Name]" and specify which right you are exercising.
privacy_s04_p1: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
privacy_s04_li3: Limited access (only CompanionAway staff can view your data)
privacy_s04_p2: However, no security system is 100% secure. While we do our best to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. You assume the risk of transmitting sensitive data.
privacy_s05_p1: We use the following third-party services, which may collect your data:
privacy_s05_li1: Stripe (payments): Handles credit card data. See stripe.com/privacy
privacy_s05_li2: Google Analytics (website tracking): Tracks usage patterns anonymously. See policies.google.com/privacy
privacy_s05_li3: Mailchimp (email): If you subscribe to our newsletter. See mailchimp.com/legal/privacy
privacy_s05_p2: We are not responsible for these services' privacy practices. Check their policies directly.
privacy_s06_p1: We keep your questionnaire and guide data for 12 months after purchase to provide customer support and handle revisions. After 12 months of inactivity, your data is securely deleted unless:
privacy_s06_li1: We are legally required to retain it (tax/legal records)
privacy_s06_li2: You have an active support case
privacy_s07_p1: Email: hello@companionaway.com with "PRIVACY QUESTION" in the subject line. Response within 2 business days.
cookies_s01_p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and understand how you use it. Cookies cannot run programs or deliver viruses.
cookies_table_r1_purpose: Login, platform access, security, CSRF protection. The platform cannot function without these.
cookies_table_r2_purpose: Remember language preference (EN/IT), display settings, form progress, questionnaire draft save.
cookies_table_r3_purpose: Google Analytics: Understand which pages are visited, user flow, time spent. Data is anonymized — we cannot identify individuals.
cookies_table_r4_purpose: We do not use marketing, advertising, or tracking cookies.
cookies_s03_p1: When you first visit CompanionAway, a cookie consent banner will appear. You can:
cookies_s03_li2: Essential only: Only allow cookies required for the platform to work (recommended for privacy)
cookies_s03_li3: Manage preferences: Individually choose which cookies to allow
cookies_s03_p2: You can change your preferences at any time by clicking "Cookie Settings" in the website footer. Disabling essential cookies will prevent you from using the platform.
cookies_s04_p1: You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when cookies are being sent. See your browser's help section for specific instructions.
cookies_s04_p2: Note: Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.
